hero.h1: Bathroom Remodeling Across Dallas-Fort Worth, Built by the Owner
hero.subheadline: Anthony Brown scopes, manages and works on every Golden Era job. Showers are custom tile over Schluter waterproofing with real cement or epoxy grout, never snap-in acrylic panels.

image.alt: Bathroom remodeling in Dallas-Fort Worth: glass-enclosed marble-look shower with several shower heads, a tiled bench and a brass towel warmer

intro.h2: One bath specialist, one owner on every job
paragraphs: Golden Era Remodel does one thing: bathroom remodeling across Dallas-Fort Worth, run from a shop in Mansfield, TX. Owner Anthony Brown started the company to focus on baths alone. When you call, you reach the person who will manage your project, not a salesperson who hands you to a crew you have never met.

The craft is tile. Showers are built on Schluter, wedi or goboard systems with real cement or epoxy grout, never premixed. You get a detailed written estimate before work begins. If rot or an old leak turns up behind the wall, Anthony stops, shows you what he found and writes a change order before doing more.

services.h2: Bathroom remodeling services across Dallas-Fort Worth

items.name: Master Bath Transformations
items.blurb: Full primary baths with custom vanities, tile, lighting, fixtures and flooring, from double vanities to heated floors and soaking tubs. Golden Era handles demo, plumbing, tile and finish work under one contract. A master bath with a walk-in shower and custom tile usually takes 4 to 6 weeks.

image.alt: Master bathroom with dark onyx-look porcelain shower walls, pebble shower floor and a floating double vanity with arched mirrors

items.name: Walk-In and Curbless Showers
items.blurb: Floor-to-ceiling tile, frameless glass, niches, benches and grab-bar blocking on request. Curbless showers get a correct pre-slope, a bonded Schluter membrane and a linear or point drain. Curbless typically adds $1,500 to $4,000 over a curbed build, and most walk-in builds take 1 to 2 weeks.

image.alt: Walk-in shower with large blue-green hexagon wall tile, a recessed niche and a sand-colored tile floor with center drain

items.name: Tub-to-Shower Conversions
items.blurb: The unused tub comes out and a custom tile walk-in shower goes in, with Schluter waterproofing, new valve, fixtures and drain, and curb or curbless entry. Most conversions run $9,000 to $20,000 and take 1 to 2 weeks, depending on tile, glass and whether plumbing moves.

image.alt: Glass-enclosed walk-in shower with handmade-look beige wall tile, a built-in bench and a raised tiled step

items.name: Custom Tile Installation
items.blurb: Ceramic, porcelain, marble, granite and travertine set with flat layouts and tight grout lines. Golden Era installs shower walls, tub surrounds, large-format and natural stone, herringbone and mosaic patterns, heated tile floors and backsplashes. Full shower tile inside a larger remodel runs about $3,500 to $9,000 or more.

image.alt: Custom tub surround in large-format marble-look porcelain with a long recessed niche and matte black fixtures

items.title: You deal with the owner
items.text: Anthony writes the estimate, manages the job and is on site for demo, waterproofing, tile layout and the final punch list. There is no rotating crew or project manager filter between you and him.

items.title: Real tile, not acrylic
items.text: Every shower is custom tile on a Schluter, wedi or goboard system with cement or epoxy grout. Google reviewers most often tag tile work, shower rebuilds and master bathroom remodels.

items.title: Prices in writing first
items.text: You get a detailed line-item quote after a free in-home visit. Unexpected problems are photographed and priced on a written change order before any extra work starts.

items.title: A year of workmanship cover
items.text: Golden Era gives a 1-year installation warranty on its workmanship and carries general liability and workers' comp on every job, with certificates of insurance on request.

about.h2: Anthony Brown, the owner who picks up the phone
about.text: Anthony Brown founded Golden Era Remodel to do one thing very well: bathroom remodeling. Working from a shop in Mansfield, Texas, the company has been in business since 2020 and serves two kinds of clients. Golden Standard homeowners in places like Garland, Arlington and Richardson want quality work at a fair, honest price. Golden Luxury homeowners in Frisco, Plano, Southlake and Colleyville want premium stone and flawless finish work. Anthony gives both the same thing: he is on the job site every day and the project is not done until you are happy.

process.h2: How a Golden Era bathroom gets built

steps.title: Free in-home estimate
steps.text: Anthony visits, measures, listens to your goals and sends a detailed written, line-item quote, usually within 48 hours of the visit.

steps.title: Design and materials
steps.text: You pick tile, fixtures and finishes yourself or with help, including visits to tile showrooms, to fit your style and budget.

steps.title: The build
steps.text: Demo, waterproofing, tile and finish work are managed start to finish by the owner, and work does not start until materials are on hand.

steps.title: Final walkthrough
steps.text: You walk the finished bath together. The job is not called done until you are happy, and the 1-year workmanship warranty begins.

service_area.h2: From Mansfield to every corner of the Metroplex
service_area.text: Golden Era works out of Mansfield and takes bathroom projects within about 45 minutes of the shop, across Tarrant, Dallas, Collin, Denton, Kaufman and Rockwall counties. The site names town pages for Westlake, Colleyville, Allen, Coppell and Flower Mound, where Anthony also handles city permits and HOA submissions when a project needs them. If your town is not listed, call or text and ask.

faq.h2: DFW bathroom remodel questions, answered by Golden Era

items.a: Yes. All in-home consultations and estimates are free and carry no obligation. Call or text (469) 586-6478 to set a time, and evenings and weekends are fine. Anthony measures, talks through your goals and usually sends a detailed line-item quote within 48 hours of the visit.

items.q: What does a bathroom remodel cost in Dallas-Fort Worth?
items.a: Most Golden Era bathroom remodels fall between $15,000 and $45,000. A guest bath refresh with new tile, vanity and fixtures is typically $15,000 to $22,000. A master bath with a walk-in shower, custom tile and stone usually lands at $30,000 to $45,000 or more. Your written quote is line by line.

items.q: How long will my bathroom be out of service?
items.a: A guest bathroom typically takes 2 to 3 weeks once work starts. A master bath with a walk-in shower and custom tile takes 4 to 6 weeks, and a full primary suite with custom millwork or natural stone takes 6 to 8. Work does not begin until all the materials are on hand.

items.q: What warranty comes with the work?
items.a: Golden Era provides a 1-year installation warranty on its workmanship. If something it installed fails because of the craftsmanship, the team comes back and makes it right. Tile, fixtures, cabinets and appliances carry their own manufacturer warranties, which typically range from 1 year to lifetime depending on the product.

items.q: How do payments and financing work?
items.a: You pay a deposit at contract signing, progress payments at set milestones such as demo, rough-in and tile, and the balance on completion. Golden Era accepts credit and debit cards, checks and NFC mobile payments. It does not offer in-house financing but can point you to HELOC and home-improvement loan options.

final_cta.h2: Book a free in-home bathroom estimate
final_cta.text: Call or text Anthony at (469) 586-6478. Evening and weekend visits are fine, and most quotes go out within 48 hours.
